trend_paragraph:
- **复杂表格任务提速**：Basis 案例称 GPT-6 Astra 处理五十页税务工作簿所需时间减半，实际准确率仍需核验。
- **开发者案例征集**：OpenAI 通过 Codex Originals 收集真实项目故事，为后续开发者案例展示寻找素材。
- **业务意图理解改善**：Basis 表示 GPT-6 Astra 对用户意图的理解提升了应用信心，但简介未披露准确率数据。

articles.title: Codex Originals 征集开发者项目故事
articles.description: We’re collecting real stories of builders, tinkerers, researchers, and creators who are using Codex to do incredible things. If you want to be a part of the next chapter of the Codex Originals program, tell us more about your story and project below.
articles.summary: OpenAI 正征集使用 Codex 的开发者、研究者与创作者的真实项目故事，作为下一阶段 Codex Originals 计划的候选案例。公告提供项目与个人故事的提交表单，没有披露新的产品功能。

articles.title: Basis 用 GPT-6 Astra 将税务表格处理提速两倍
articles.description: GPT-6 Astra completed a 50-tab tax workbook twice as fast as GPT-5.6 Sol, and its stronger understanding of user intent gives Basis more confidence in real-world use.
articles.summary: OpenAI 发布 Basis 的税务工作簿案例，称 GPT-6 Astra 完成包含 50 个标签页的工作簿所需时间约为 GPT-5.6 Sol 的一半。案例同时强调对用户意图的理解改善，但缓存仅含简介，未提供测试方法或更广泛的准确率数据。
practice_suggestions: 选取脱敏的多标签页税务工作簿，对比处理时间并人工复核计算结果。

articles.title: GPT-6 Sol 与 Luna 升级：能力提升与任务降本
articles.description:
GPT-6 Sol and Luna are big improvements on intelligence, alignment, work output, coding, computer use, and more over their 5.6-family predecessors.

They are also half the price per token, and even less per task!
articles.summary: Sam Altman 称 GPT-6 Sol 与 Luna 相比 5.6 系列前代，在智能、对齐、编程和计算机操作等方面有所提升。其公布的每 token 价格为前代的一半，并称按任务计算的成本还可更低。他进一步主张用完成任务的总成本评价模型价格，以支持更广泛的 AI 使用与探索。缓存未提供独立基准或详细价目表，竞争优势仍属于官方表态。
practice_suggestions: 用固定任务集比较新旧模型的成功率与单次成功任务成本。

articles.title: Altman 主张以每任务成本衡量模型价格
articles.description:
Especially compared by per-task pricing, which is the metric that should matter, I don't think there is anything competitive anywhere in the market.

We want people to be able to use tons of AI; it is important to being able to explore this new renaissance in front of us.

quoted_tweet.author: sama
quoted_tweet.text:
GPT-6 Sol and Luna are big improvements on intelligence, alignment, work output, coding, computer use, and more over their 5.6-family predecessors.

They are also half the price per token, and even less per task!

articles.summary: Altman 在引用 GPT-6 Sol 与 Luna 升级公告时，强调用户应比较完成任务的总成本，而不仅看 token 单价。他认为更低成本有助于扩大 AI 使用与探索，但竞争优势属于其个人判断。

articles.title: OpenAI 希望 API 覆盖各价位和多模态需求
articles.description:
We want the OpenAI API to feature the best model at every price point and to be the best at every modality (text, code, image, video, etc).

And then we want you all to come up with great ideas and build them and to get to be happy users. The best ideas will come from you all.
articles.summary: Altman 表示 OpenAI 希望 API 在各价格档位提供有竞争力的模型，并覆盖文本、代码、图像和视频等模态。他把应用创意与开发重心交给开发者，本条属于产品战略表态，没有宣布具体功能或上线时间。

articles.title: Altman 肯定团队持续试验与组织更新
articles.description:
michelle embodies this as much as anyone

openai is so, so lucky to have benefited from everything she has done so far and i think people will be quite pleased to see what she + team have cooking next!

quoted_tweet.author: michpokrass
quoted_tweet.text:
just crossed four years at openai!

the special thing about this place is the constant capacity for rebirth. for all its faults, there is nowhere quite like it. the team makes high conviction, contrarian bets over and over, and they are mostly right. it's a new company every three months. 

i have really enjoyed my part in some of the bets, and i'm excited to share some of the current ones we are cooking up now. onward!

articles.summary: Altman 转引 Michelle Pokrass 的任职四周年感言，肯定其团队对 OpenAI 的贡献，并表示期待后续项目。原文强调团队持续做高信念的逆向选择与组织更新，未公开新项目的名称或功能。

articles.title: Altman 讨论大公司保持敏捷的难题
articles.description: Startups are naturally good at this; it is hard to keep a bigger company good at this and i think an underexplored space.

quoted_tweet.author: prd_008
quoted_tweet.text:
OpenAI's superpower is the ability to swiftly assemble an empowered group of highly capable people to work on the most important and urgent thing at any point of time. 

No one really cares for org lines. It's how we stay nimble, seize opportunities, and recover from mistakes.

articles.summary: Altman 转引一则关于 OpenAI 临时组建高能力授权团队的观察，认可这种跨组织边界的协作方式。他指出初创公司天然更擅长敏捷行动，而大型公司维持这种能力仍有研究空间。

articles.title: Thariq 展示 Opus 5.5 网站迭代设计
articles.description:
I asked Opus 5.5 to try a bunch of redesigns of my personal website using my MAX sub, using workflows to iterate and critique.

I was really pleased with how it hit the tone I was looking for. 

Then I asked it to make a trailer with all of its iterations. https://t.co/NLDxQDAQRk
articles.summary: Thariq 描述使用 MAX 订阅中的 Opus 5.5 反复重设计个人网站，并通过工作流进行迭代和点评。他表示设计较好地匹配了预期风格，随后要求模型为迭代过程制作预告片；缓存没有可供核验的成品细节。
practice_suggestions: 为网站改版定义风格目标，分轮生成方案并要求模型逐项点评。

articles.title: Opus 5.5 使用探索：创作、网站设计与任务委派
articles.description:
A thread of early explorations with Claude Opus 5.5:

A short story about a watermelon created by @kevin_t_ngo. https://t.co/v48srlNi7V
articles.summary: Claude 官方展示 Opus 5.5 的早期创作探索，包括用户制作的西瓜主题短篇故事。另一案例通过迭代与点评工作流重设计个人网站，并进一步生成迭代过程的预告片。开发者指南建议交付完整任务，预先定义完成标准和汇报节点，并在长任务后确认后续推进条件。这些材料侧重使用方式与案例，缓存没有性能基准或链接正文。
practice_suggestions: 为完整任务明确完成标准与汇报节点。
为网站改版定义风格目标，分轮生成方案并要求模型点评。
长任务结束后核对结果，并询问继续推进所需材料。

articles.title: Claude Devs 分享 Opus 5.5 整体任务指南
articles.description:
Try these in your first Opus 5.5 session:

→ Hand over a whole task. Define "done" and when to check in.
→ Drop "think carefully". It always thinks first.
→ After a long run, check what it needs to go further.

Our playbook: https://t.co/h4Vz9BIl0z
articles.summary: Claude Devs 建议首次使用 Opus 5.5 时交付完整任务，事先明确完成标准和需要汇报的节点。指南称模型会先思考，因此无需重复要求仔细思考，并建议长任务结束后询问继续推进所需条件；链接正文未缓存。

articles.title: GPT-6 API 改进提示缓存命中率
articles.description:
We’ve improved prompt caching in the API for GPT-6, helping agents run faster and cost less.

Higher cache-hit rates by default mean more input tokens benefit from cached-input discounts of up to 90%.
 https://t.co/NZse8QKr8G
articles.summary: OpenAI Devs 宣布 GPT-6 API 默认提示缓存命中率有所提高，以降低智能体运行时间和费用。公告称更多输入 token 可享受最高 90% 的缓存输入折扣，但未披露各场景命中率或实测收益。
practice_suggestions: 在既有 Agent 工作负载中记录缓存命中率、端到端耗时与实际账单变化。

articles.title: 开发者将 Astra 与真实星图结合制作导航项目
articles.description:
Get lost in your side projects.

One builder at our GPT-6 hackathons brought real star maps and Astra to help you find your way home. https://t.co/D9lkBA7ar4
articles.summary: OpenAI Devs 分享 GPT-6 黑客松中的一个副项目：开发者将真实星图与 Astra 结合，探索帮助用户找路的应用。公告未给出项目名称、技术实现或导航效果验证，因此适合作为应用创意案例观察。
practice_suggestions: 以星图识别为原型任务，测试模型输出与已知天文位置的吻合程度。
